name: The Chromatic Chameleon Forest
description: A forest where every tree, leaf, and creature shifts color in response to emotions projected by visitors -- fear makes blue spirals, joy creates golden fractals, curiosity ripples through violet gradients -- creating a living mood ring landscape.
prompt: A dense magical forest where bark, leaves, vines, and creatures are living color-shifting surfaces. In one area, trees ripple with golden fractal patterns (joy). Nearby, blue spiral patterns pulse on ferns (melancholy). Violet gradients wash through canopy leaves (wonder). Crimson geometric bursts on flower petals (passion). The forest floor shows footprints that bloom in the walker's emotional color. Translucent chameleon-like creatures crawl branches, their skin displaying moving mandalas of feeling. Ethereal glow, bioluminescence, subsurface scattering in organic matter. First-person perspective showing color ripples spreading from viewer's position.
caption: The forest feels what you feel. 🌈🌳 Walk with joy and the leaves turn gold. Pause in wonder and violet ripples through the canopy. Your heart paints the woods in real time. What color are you today?
